title: Wavex Tyre Polish for Car & Bike 1 L with Tyre Dresser Brush | Long Lasting Super Black Shine | Non-Greasy, Super Hydrophobic Formula | Gives Lustrous Dark Finish
description: Transform dull, faded tyres into a deep, super black masterpiece with our Tyre Polish for Car & Bike. Designed with an advanced non-greasy, hydrophobic formula, it delivers a long-lasting, lustrous shine that repels water and dirt — keeping your tyres looking new for days. Each bottle comes with a premium tyre dresser brush that ensures smooth, even application and prevents wastage. Whether you’re detailing your car at home or maintaining your bike’s look, this polish provides a professional-grade finish with minimal effort. Enjoy a durable, UV-protected shine that doesn’t attract dust or feel oily to the touch. Perfect for car enthusiasts, professional detailers, and anyone who wants tyres that look as impressive as the rest of their vehicle.
